title: Plug at Foot of the Bed is Horrible
text: Plug at Foot of the Bed is Horrible. I like everything about this heated mattress pad EXCEPT the plug at the foot of the bed, which is why I gave it only 3 stars.  My feet constantly run into the plus, and it's hard.  Needs to be redesigned and I will definitely pay better attention next time.  Otherwise, it's fine . . . but that's enough of a NO for me.

product_metadata.title: Sunbeam Restful Heated Mattress Pad - Full
features: Easy to use heated mattress pad with digital controller, with 12 heat settings and 12-hour selectable auto-shut off function for peace of mind
Queen and King sizes include 2 controllers for independent control & customized warmth on each side of the bed
Machine washable & dryer safe for easy care
The soft, cozy fabric is made with 100% polyester
description: Sleep comfortably with the Sunbeam Restful Heated Mattress Pad. This easy-to-use mattress pad comes equipped with 12 heat settings to accommodate all your comfort needs. Simply adjust the warmth using the detachable digital controllers. Fall asleep with peace of mind thanks to the bult-in 12-hour selectable auto-shut off function. Remove controllers and place mattress pad in the washer and dryer for easy maintenance.
